targets.writeCondition: One Update per joining with gen_joiningstatus = 7 (source WHERE, DTSX:980-984) whose padded bank account number right('0000000000000' + gen_bankaccountnumbername,12) matches right('0000000000000' + gen_bankaccountnumber,12) of a Gen_customeraccount with non-NULL gen_bankaccountnumber (Lookup 'Get customer accounts', DTSX:914-919). Lookup NoMatchBehavior=1 (redirect to No Match output, DTSX:927) and the No Match output has no path (paths DTSX:1876-1880) -> joinings without a matching customer account are silently dropped (no update, no warning). Rows whose SDK call throws go to the Error output -> 'Set Warning columns 1 2 1' -> ETL Warning (plumbing).

targets.expression: entity["gen_customeraccountid"] = new EntityReference("gen_customeraccount", Row.GencustomeraccountId); Gen_customeraccountId is returned by Lookup 'Get customer accounts' from CRM Gen_customeraccount.Gen_customeraccountId, joined on gen_bankaccountnumber = right('0000000000000' + Gen_customeraccount.gen_bankaccountnumber,12) (left-padded with zeros to 12 chars; values longer than 12 chars keep only their last 12 chars) against the source column right('0000000000000' + gen_automatedjoining.gen_bankaccountnumbername,12). Full-cache lookup (CacheType=0): if several customer accounts share the same padded number, SSIS uses one of them (the first cached) - which one is not determined by the package.

targets.writeCondition: Runs after 'Close Joining processes' -> 'Get NonWorkingDays' -> 'Update LastThreeWorkingDays Variable' (Success constraints DTSX:6510, 6509, 6511). One Update per joining WHERE gen_joiningstatus = 7 AND gen_sendtobankdate IS NOT NULL AND datediff(day, ?, gen_sendtobankdate) <= 0 (DTSX:5541-5544), ? = User::LastThreeWorkingDays (ParameterMapping DTSX:5549 -> variable DTSX:42). I.e. joinings still in status 7 after the close step (no matching customer account, or SDK update failed) whose send-to-bank date (date part, as stored, no time-zone conversion in the SQL) is on or before LastThreeWorkingDays. LastThreeWorkingDays is computed by Script Task 'Update LastThreeWorkingDays Variable' (ScriptMain.cs:107-134): starting from DateTime.Now.AddDays(-1).Date it walks back day by day, skipping days present in User::NonWorkingDays (CalendarRule starttime of 'Friday'/'Saturday'/'Holiday' rules within the last 21 days, Execute SQL DTSX:4090-4091), and returns the 3rd working day counting yesterday as the 1st.

Meaning of 12 per column name 'suspicionAsEmitted' only (CRM option metadata not supplied).

unresolved.where: Update SuspicionAsEmitted Joinings\Update Joinings - row selection via User::LastThreeWorkingDays
unresolved.reason: Update LastThreeWorkingDays Variable ScriptMain.cs:121 matches non-working days with dt.Select("starttime = '" + currDate.ToString() + "'"): currDate is local midnight formatted with the runtime culture, while CalendarRule.starttime is read as stored (the SQL compares it against GetutcDate()). Whether these strings/values ever match (and therefore whether Fridays/Saturdays/holidays are really skipped) depends on the server culture, time zone and CalendarRule data - not determinable from the DTSX.

notes.note: Writers in lineage (4): 2 business CRM writers mapped here (3 attributes in total: Update to close joining 2, Update Joinings 1). Excluded as ETL plumbing: Close Joining processes\ETL Warning 1 2 1 (creates gen_etlprocesswarning, main.cs:63-76) and End ETL Process record\ETL Record Finish (updates gen_etlprocess, main.cs:120-129). Also plumbing (control flow / event handlers, not data-flow writers): Create ETL Process record (gen_etlprocess create), OnError\Error ETL Process record (gen_etlprocess update + annotation on gen_etlprocess, ScriptMain.cs:49-64), OnPostExecute\Cancel ETL Process record, Get Variables From Etl Variables.

Status chain on gen_automatedjoining: 'Close Joining processes' moves status 7 -> 8 for joinings whose bank account number matches a customer account and sets gen_customeraccountid; afterwards 'Update SuspicionAsEmitted Joinings' moves remaining status-7 joinings with gen_sendtobankdate on/before LastThreeWorkingDays -> 12. Order proven by Success constraints DTSX:6506-6511.

Update LastThreeWorkingDays Variable ScriptMain.cs:96-104: on exception the catch sets TaskResult = Failure but line 104 unconditionally sets Success afterwards, so the package continues and User::LastThreeWorkingDays keeps its previous value (design-time value '10/2/2017 5:29:05 PM', DTSX:42, unless set by configuration - not supplied). In that case the cut-off date of the suspicion update would be 2017-10-02.

Close Joining processes: rows with NULL gen_bankaccountnumbername produce a NULL key ('0000000000000' + NULL = NULL) and do not match the lookup -> dropped (no-match output unconnected, DTSX:927, 1876-1880). SSIS semantics; stated as such.

Both writers catch exceptions per row (SoapException -> e.Detail.InnerText, others -> e.Message) and redirect the row to the Error output; only 'Update to close joining' has its Error output connected (to the ETL warning branch, DTSX:1878). 'Update Joinings' Error output has no path (paths DTSX:6498-6499) - failed suspicion updates are silently discarded.
